caseName: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp. v. Public Service Commission
caseNameFull: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp. v. Public Service Commission of New York

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 3d Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
